answer: One defense is refundable stake-bonding: each agent must lock collateral before it can earn or attest. An honest node posts a single bond; a sybil operator must post one per fake identity, so forging a thousand selves costs a thousand bonds. That locked stake is a costly signal of commitment that cheap talk cannot fake, and misbehavior burns it like melting a copper coin. Reputation then climbs toward a trust summit only through sustained bonded conduct, making mass fake identities economically pointless.
